descriptionZh: 苦、甘、香三味一体的等比经典，三种基酒平衡得几近完美。
descriptionEn: The equal-parts Italian classic where bitter, sweet and botanical spirit meet in perfect balance.
storyNoteZh: 1919 年意大利佛罗伦萨 Camillo Negroni 伯爵要求把 Americano 中的苏打水换成金酒，自此诞生。
storyNoteEn: Born in 1919 in Florence when Count Camillo Negroni asked to replace the soda in his Americano with gin.

descriptionZh: 威士忌 + 糖 + 苦精的极简组合，最古老的鸡尾酒之一。
descriptionEn: Whiskey, sugar, bitters and ice — the foundational template from which almost every stirred drink descends.
storyNoteZh: 19 世纪末肯塔基州 Pendennis Club 调酒师首创，名字直指「老派」。
storyNoteEn: Created at Louisville's Pendennis Club in the late 1800s, the cocktail that defined the word 'cocktail' itself.

descriptionZh: 龙舌兰的辛辣、橙酒的甜、青柠的酸——墨西哥三元素完美融合。
descriptionEn: Tequila's bite, orange liqueur's sweetness and lime's sharpness — the Mexican trinity in one glass.
storyNoteZh: 1930-50 年代墨西哥社交名流 Margarita Sames 在 Acapulco 家中首创。
storyNoteEn: Popularly credited to socialite Margarita Sames at her Acapulco home in the late 1940s.

descriptionZh: 白朗姆 + 青柠 + 糖，简洁却极致平衡的酸型鸡尾酒标杆。
descriptionEn: White rum, lime and sugar — three ingredients done right is the whole point.
storyNoteZh: 1898 年古巴 Daiquiri 矿区美国工程师 Jennings Cox 发明，是 Hemingway 的心头好。
storyNoteEn: Invented in 1898 by American engineer Jennings Cox in the Daiquiri mines of Cuba — a Hemingway favourite.

descriptionZh: 黑麦威士忌与甜味美思的深色交响，苦精点到即止。
descriptionEn: Rye whiskey and sweet vermouth in a deep, dark duet, finished with a whisper of bitters.
storyNoteZh: 19 世纪末纽约 Manhattan Club 调酒师为丘吉尔母亲 Jenny Jerome 调制的酒。
storyNoteEn: Created in the 1870s-80s at New York's Manhattan Club, allegedly for Lady Randolph Churchill.

descriptionZh: 金酒与干味美思的极简对话，最纯粹的鸡尾酒形态之一。
descriptionEn: Gin and dry vermouth in the most stripped-down dialogue in the cocktail world.
storyNoteZh: 19 世纪末从 Martinez 演化而来，丘吉尔「看酒不看味」的故事是调酒界永恒传奇。
storyNoteEn: Evolved from the Martinez in the late 1800s; Churchill's 'just glance at the vermouth' is bar legend.

descriptionZh: 波本的甘、柠檬的酸、蛋清的绵密——古典酸酒的现代演绎。
descriptionEn: Bourbon's warmth, lemon's bite, egg white's silk — the modern revival of a pre-prohibition sour.
storyNoteZh: 1862 年《Bartender's Guide》首次收录；蛋清版本因 Boston's Eastern Standard 餐厅而复兴。
storyNoteEn: First recorded in Jerry Thomas's 1862 Bartender's Guide; the egg-white version was revived at Boston's Eastern Standard.

descriptionZh: 白朗姆、薄荷、青柠与苏打水的古巴高球，海明威的哈瓦那标配。
descriptionEn: White rum, mint, lime and soda — Hemingway's Havana in a tall glass.
storyNoteZh: 16 世纪古巴的「El Draque」以朗姆、薄荷、青柠治病的鸡尾酒前身，海明威让之名扬世界。
storyNoteEn: Descended from 16th-century Cuban 'El Draque', a rum-mint-lime remedy; Hemingway popularised it worldwide.

descriptionZh: 伏特加、君度、蔓越莓与青柠的粉红鸡尾酒，1990 年代纽约潮人标志。
descriptionEn: Vodka, Cointreau, cranberry and lime in the pink drink that defined a 1990s New York aesthetic.
storyNoteZh: 1980 年代末由 Toby Cecchini 在纽约 Liquidasset 改良定型，因《欲望都市》风靡全球。
storyNoteEn: Refined by Toby Cecchini at New York's Liquidasset in the late 1980s and made famous by Sex and the City.

descriptionZh: 伏特加、姜汁啤酒与青柠，铜杯装的清爽高球。
descriptionEn: Vodka, ginger beer and lime served ice-cold in a copper mug.
storyNoteZh: 1941 年洛杉矶 Cock'n Bull 餐厅老板与伏特加代理商联手推广铜杯时发明。
storyNoteEn: Concocted in 1941 in Los Angeles when Cock 'n' Bull restaurant teamed up with vodka importers to clear copper mugs.

descriptionZh: 阿佩罗、普罗赛克与苏打水的橙红开胃酒，意大利夏日标配。
descriptionEn: Aperol, prosecco and soda in the orange aperitivo that put Italian summers on the map.
storyNoteZh: 1919 年意大利 Padova 的 Barbieri 兄弟创立 Aperol，Spritz 形式在 2000 年代被全球接受。
storyNoteEn: Aperol was created in 1919 by the Barbieri brothers in Padova; the spritz format went global in the 2000s.

descriptionZh: 波本版的 Negroni，香草橡木与苦橙的暖色组合。
descriptionEn: The bourbon Negroni — sweet vanilla oak against bitter orange Italian aperitivo.
storyNoteZh: 1927 年旅居巴黎的美国人 Erskinne Gwynne 创办 Boulevardier 杂志时命名此酒。
storyNoteEn: Named by American ex-pat Erskinne Gwynne in his 1927 Paris magazine Boulevardier.

descriptionZh: 调和威士忌、姜蜜糖浆与艾雷岛浮酒，现代经典中的现代经典。
descriptionEn: Blended scotch, ginger-honey syrup and a peated Islay float — a modern classic by Sam Ross.
storyNoteZh: 2005 年纽约 Milk & Honey 调酒师 Sam Ross 创作，被誉为 21 世纪最有影响力的鸡尾酒之一。
storyNoteEn: Created in 2005 by Sam Ross at New York's Milk & Honey, one of the most influential cocktails of the 21st century.

descriptionZh: 等比的金酒、绿查特、马拉斯奇诺与青柠，草药与花香的紧凑对位。
descriptionEn: Equal parts gin, green Chartreuse, Maraschino and lime — herbaceous and floral in perfect proportion.
storyNoteZh: 1916 年底特律 Detroit Athletic Club 发明，禁酒令时期消失，2004 年由 Murray Stenson 在 Seattle 重启。
storyNoteEn: Born in 1916 at the Detroit Athletic Club, lost after Prohibition and revived in 2004 by Murray Stenson at the Zig Zag Café in Seattle.

descriptionZh: 波本、阿佩罗、杏仁酒与柠檬等比，入口先苦后甜。
descriptionEn: Equal parts bourbon, Aperol, Amaretto and lemon — bitter first, sweet finish.
storyNoteZh: 2007 年芝加哥 Violet Hour 调酒师 Sam Ross 创作，M83 乐队专辑名同款。
storyNoteEn: Created in 2007 by Sam Ross at Chicago's Violet Hour, named after an M83 song.

descriptionZh: 黑麦、干邑与甜味美思的三重奏，新奥尔良法国区的灵魂。
descriptionEn: Rye, cognac and sweet vermouth layered with Bénédictine — the cocktail of the New Orleans French Quarter.
storyNoteZh: 1938 年蒙特利尔 Carousel Bar 调酒师 Walter Bergeron 创作。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1938 by Walter Bergeron at the Carousel Bar of the Hotel Monteleone in New Orleans.

descriptionZh: 波本、薄荷与碎冰的肯塔基传统，Kentucky Derby 必备。
descriptionEn: Bourbon, mint and crushed ice in the silver cup — Kentucky Derby ritual since the 1800s.
storyNoteZh: 美国南方 18 世纪的传统冷饮，Kentucky Derby 每年消耗上万杯。
storyNoteEn: A southern American tradition since the 1700s; tens of thousands are served at the Kentucky Derby each year.

descriptionZh: 金酒、樱桃希林、菠萝汁与石榴糖浆的复杂热带高球。
descriptionEn: Gin, Cherry Heering, pineapple and grenadine in the long, layered tropical highball from Raffles.
storyNoteZh: 1915 年新加坡 Raffles 酒店调酒师 Ngiam Tong Boon 创作，是酒店最具代表性的一杯。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1915 by Ngiam Tong Boon at the Long Bar of Singapore's Raffles Hotel.

descriptionZh: 陈年朗姆、杏仁糖浆与青柠的 tiki 之王，配 Orgeat 才是真品。
descriptionEn: Aged rum, orgeat and lime — the tiki king, properly made with real orgeat.
storyNoteZh: 1944 年 Trader Vic 调酒师 Victor Bergeron 在加州 Oakland 创作。
storyNoteEn: Concocted in 1944 by Victor 'Trader Vic' Bergeron at his Oakland restaurant.

descriptionZh: 秘鲁皮斯科葡萄烈酒、青柠与蛋清泡沫，南美酸酒之王。
descriptionEn: Peruvian pisco, lime and a velvety egg-white foam — the South American answer to the Whiskey Sour.
storyNoteZh: 1920 年代秘鲁 Lima Morris' Bar 调酒师 Victor Morris 改良，秘鲁国饮。
storyNoteEn: Refined in 1920s Lima by Victor Morris; declared Peru's national cocktail.

descriptionZh: 伏特加、番茄汁与伍斯特酱的咸鲜 brunch 标配。
descriptionEn: Vodka, tomato juice and Worcestershire in the umami-rich brunch staple.
storyNoteZh: 1920 年代巴黎 Harry's New York Bar 调酒师 Fernand Petiot 创作，1934 年带到纽约。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1920s Paris by Fernand Petiot at Harry's New York Bar, brought to NYC in 1934.

descriptionZh: 金酒、柠檬与香槟的轻盈战斗鸡尾酒，名字来自一战火炮。
descriptionEn: Gin, lemon and Champagne in the light, sharp drink named after a WWI field gun.
storyNoteZh: 1915 年巴黎 Harry's New York Bar 首现，名字取自 75mm 大炮的强劲后坐力。
storyNoteEn: First recorded at Harry's New York Bar in Paris in 1915; named for the kick of the 75mm field gun.

descriptionZh: 金酒、柠檬与苏打水的清爽高球，是 Gin Fizz 的高杯版本。
descriptionEn: Gin, lemon and soda in the tall, refreshing version of the Gin Fizz.
storyNoteZh: 1876 年由纽约调酒师 John Collins 首创，名字随 1874 年 'Tom Collins Hoax' 流行而走红。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1876 by New York bartender John Collins; 'Tom' became the popular name after a 1874 hoax.

descriptionZh: 金酒与汤力水的极简组合，英国殖民奎宁药水的优雅后裔。
descriptionEn: Gin and tonic — the elegant colonial descendant of a British anti-malaria quinine mix.
storyNoteZh: 19 世纪英国驻印度军队把奎宁水与金酒混饮以缓解疟疾，G&T 自此诞生。
storyNoteEn: British troops in 19th-century India mixed quinine tonic with gin to take their medicine; the G&T was born.

descriptionZh: 金酒、柠檬与碎冰上淋黑莓酒，新派英国经典。
descriptionEn: Gin, lemon and crushed ice, finished with a generous pour of Crème de Mûre.
storyNoteZh: 1984 年伦敦市中心 Townhouse 酒吧的 Dick Bradsell 创作。
storyNoteEn: Concocted in 1984 by Dick Bradsell at the Townhouse bar in central London.

descriptionZh: 黑朗姆漂浮在姜汁啤酒上，百慕大 Gosling's 家族的注册配方。
descriptionEn: Dark rum floating on ginger beer — Bermuda's Gosling family trademark.
storyNoteZh: 百慕大 Gosling's 家族品牌，配方为商业机密，只在百慕大用 Gosling's 商标。
storyNoteEn: Trademarked by the Gosling family of Bermuda; the recipe is a family secret.

descriptionZh: 伏特加、现磨浓缩与咖啡酒的三层泡沫，1980 年代末伦敦诞生的现代经典。
descriptionEn: Vodka, fresh espresso and coffee liqueur, shaken to a thick crema on top.
storyNoteZh: 1983 年伦敦 Soho 区 Fred's Club 调酒师 Dick Bradsell 应一位年轻超模要求「给我一杯能叫醒我的酒」而创作。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1983 by Dick Bradsell at Fred's Club in Soho, London, for a young model who asked for a drink 'to wake me up'.

descriptionZh: 龙舌兰与西柚苏打的清爽高球，墨西哥最常被点的鸡尾酒。
descriptionEn: Tequila and grapefruit soda in the refreshing highball that's Mexico's most-ordered cocktail.
storyNoteZh: 传说 1930-50 年代墨西哥 Don Javier Delgado Corona 在 La Capilla 酒吧创作。
storyNoteEn: Popularly credited to Don Javier Delgado Corona at La Capilla in Mexico, mid-20th century.

descriptionZh: 杏仁酒、柠檬与蛋清的现代版本，Jeffrey Morgenthaler 的经典改良。
descriptionEn: Amaretto, lemon and egg white, in the modern version popularised by Jeffrey Morgenthaler.
storyNoteZh: 原始版本 1970 年代流行，2012 年 Jeffrey Morgenthaler 加入波本与蛋清使其脱胎换骨。
storyNoteEn: Popular in the 1970s; Morgenthaler reworked it with bourbon and egg white in 2012.

descriptionZh: 苏格兰威士忌与蜂蜜利口酒 Drambuie 的极简温暖组合。
descriptionEn: Scotch and Drambuie — honey and malt in the simplest warm stirred drink.
storyNoteZh: 1960 年代纽约 21 Club 调酒师首创，名字据说得自客人的领带颜色。
storyNoteEn: Created at Manhattan's 21 Club in the 1960s; the name allegedly came from a regular's tie.

descriptionZh: 金酒、马拉斯奇诺、紫罗兰与柠檬的紫蓝色花系经典。
descriptionEn: Gin, maraschino, crème de violette and lemon — the sky-blue floral classic.
storyNoteZh: 1916 年 Hugo Ensslin《Recipes for Mixed Drinks》首载，禁酒令后几乎失传，Creme de Violette 2007 年回归后复兴。
storyNoteEn: First published in Hugo Ensslin's 1916 Recipes for Mixed Drinks; revived in 2007 when Crème de Violette returned to the US market.

descriptionZh: 等比金酒、丽蕾白、君度、柠檬配苦艾酒洗杯——醒酒日的标准。
descriptionEn: Equal parts gin, Lillet Blanc, Cointreau and lemon with an absinthe rinse — the hair-of-the-dog classic.
storyNoteZh: 1930 年 Harry Craddock《Savoy Cocktail Book》收录，号称「能唤醒死人」。
storyNoteEn: Recorded in Harry Craddock's 1930 Savoy Cocktail Book as a 'corpse reviver that will revive the dead'.

descriptionZh: 白朗姆、西柚与马拉斯奇诺的无糖 Daiquiri 变奏，又称 Papa Doble。
descriptionEn: White rum, grapefruit and maraschino — the sugar-free Daiquiri also known as Papa Doble.
storyNoteZh: 1930 年代古巴 El Floridita 调酒师 Constante 为嗜甜的 Hemingway 改良。
storyNoteEn: Devised in 1930s Havana at El Floridita by bartender Constantino Ribalaigua Vert for Hemingway's sweet tooth.

descriptionZh: 苹果白兰地、柠檬与石榴糖浆的粉红色酸酒，禁酒令前的美国经典。
descriptionEn: Applejack, lemon and grenadine in the pink pre-prohibition American classic.
storyNoteZh: 20 世纪初新泽西州起源，'Jack Rose' 名字据说得自 New Jersey 苹果花 Rosa rugosa 的颜色。
storyNoteEn: Originated in early 20th-century New Jersey; the name is said to come from the colour of the Rosa rugosa apple blossom.

descriptionZh: 金酒、蜂蜜糖浆与柠檬的禁酒令时期美国经典，蜂蜜也遮盖了劣质金酒的苦味。
descriptionEn: Gin, honey syrup and lemon — the Prohibition-era classic that used honey to mask bad bootleg gin.
storyNoteZh: 1920-30 年代纽约与巴黎流行，'bee's knees' 是当时俚语，意为 'the best'。
storyNoteEn: Popular in 1920s-30s New York and Paris; 'bee's knees' was 1920s slang for 'the best'.

descriptionZh: Pimm's No.1 与柠檬汽水、黄瓜薄荷的英式夏日长饮。
descriptionEn: Pimm's No.1, lemonade, cucumber and mint — the quintessential English summer long drink.
storyNoteZh: 1823 年伦敦 oyster bar 老板 James Pimm 发明，Wimbledon 与 Henley Regatta 的标志饮品。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1823 by James Pimm at his London oyster bar; a fixture at Wimbledon and Henley Regatta.

descriptionZh: 金酒、青柠、薄荷与简单糖浆，Southside Fizz 的静态版本。
descriptionEn: Gin, lime, mint and simple syrup — the still version of the Southside Fizz.
storyNoteZh: 1920 年代芝加哥 South Side 区 21 Club 起源，传说 Al Capone 帮派据点。
storyNoteEn: Originated in 1920s Chicago, possibly at the 21 Club on the city's South Side, near Al Capone's territory.

descriptionZh: 三种朗姆、falernum 与 Donn's Mix 的 Don the Beachcomber 招牌 tiki 巨作。
descriptionEn: Three rums, falernum and Donn's Mix — Donn Beach's legendary tiki giant.
storyNoteZh: 1934 年好莱坞 Don the Beachcomber 餐厅 Donn Beach 创作，配方至今部分保密。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1934 by Donn Beach at his Hollywood Don the Beachcomber restaurant; parts of the recipe remain secret.

descriptionZh: 淡朗姆与黑朗姆、百香果、橙汁与石榴糖浆的新奥尔良 tiki 经典。
descriptionEn: Light and dark rum with passion fruit, orange and grenadine in a New Orleans tiki classic.
storyNoteZh: 1940 年代 Pat O'Brien 酒吧调酒师发明，因为卖不掉的朗姆需要消化而调配。
storyNoteEn: Concocted in 1940s at Pat O'Brien's bar to clear a surplus of rum; served in hurricane-lamp-shaped glasses.

descriptionZh: 干邑、绿查特、马拉斯奇诺与柠檬的 Death & Co 标志鸡尾酒。
descriptionEn: Cognac, Green Chartreuse, Maraschino and lemon — the signature Death & Co. cocktail.
storyNoteZh: 2007 年纽约 Death & Co 调酒师 Eben Freeman 创作，受法国 Last Word 启发改用干邑。
storyNoteEn: Concocted in 2007 by Eben Freeman at Death & Co. in New York, a French cognac twist on the Last Word.

descriptionZh: 金酒、干味美思、马拉斯奇诺与苦艾酒洗杯的 19 世纪经典。
descriptionEn: Gin, dry vermouth, maraschino and an absinthe rinse — the 19th-century gentleman's cocktail.
storyNoteZh: 1882 年 Harry Johnson《New and Improved Bartender's Manual》首次记录。
storyNoteEn: First published in Harry Johnson's 1882 New and Improved Bartender's Manual.

descriptionZh: 黑麦、甜味美思、马拉斯奇诺与苦精的 19 世纪改良版古典。
descriptionEn: Rye, sweet vermouth, maraschino and bitters — the 19th-century upgrade of the Old Fashioned.
storyNoteZh: Jerry Thomas 1876 年《Bon Vivant's Companion》收录，是 Old Fashioned 的加料版本。
storyNoteEn: Recorded in Jerry Thomas's 1876 Bon Vivant's Companion as a richer take on the Whiskey Cocktail.

descriptionZh: 金酒、甜味美思与 Fernet 苦酒的英伦经典。
descriptionEn: Gin, sweet vermouth and Fernet-Branca — the bitter London-Italian stirred classic.
storyNoteZh: 1903 年伦敦 Savoy Hotel 调酒师 Harry Craddock 为演员 Charles Hawtrey 创作。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1903 by Harry Craddock at the Savoy Hotel in London for actor Charles Hawtrey.

descriptionZh: 黑麦、干味美思、马拉斯奇诺与 Amer Picon 的 Manhattan 失散兄弟。
descriptionEn: Rye, dry vermouth, maraschino and a touch of amaro — the Manhattan variant that almost disappeared.
storyNoteZh: 1908 年《Recipes for Mixed Drinks》作者 Jack Grohusko 创作，因 Amer Picon 难买而几近失传。
storyNoteEn: Created around 1908 by Jack Grohusko; it nearly vanished because the key ingredient, Amer Picon, was hard to find in the US.

descriptionZh: 金酒、甜味美思、马拉斯奇诺与橙皮苦精——干马天尼的前身。
descriptionEn: Gin, sweet vermouth, maraschino and orange bitters — the direct ancestor of the Dry Martini.
storyNoteZh: 1884 年加州奥克兰 bartender Jerry Thomas 创制，被认为是 Martini 的直接前身。
storyNoteEn: First attributed to Jerry Thomas in 1884 Oakland; considered the Martini's direct ancestor.

descriptionZh: 方糖、苦精与香槟的最简优雅起泡鸡尾酒。
descriptionEn: Sugar cube, bitters and Champagne — the simplest elegant sparkling classic.
storyNoteZh: 1862 年 Jerry Thomas《Bartender's Guide》最早记录，最古老的起泡鸡尾酒之一。
storyNoteEn: First recorded in Jerry Thomas's 1862 Bartender's Guide, one of the oldest sparkling cocktails.

descriptionZh: 等比干邑、白朗姆与君度配柠檬，Sidecar 的醉人兄弟。
descriptionEn: Equal parts cognac, white rum and Cointreau with lemon — the inebriating cousin of the Sidecar.
storyNoteZh: 1930 年代巴黎 Harry's New York Bar 调酒师 Harry MacElhone 创作。
storyNoteEn: Concocted in 1930s Paris by Harry MacElhone at Harry's New York Bar.

descriptionZh: 黑麦、方糖、Peychaud's 与苦艾酒洗杯，新奥尔良的官方鸡尾酒。
descriptionEn: Rye, sugar, Peychaud's bitters and an absinthe rinse — New Orleans' official cocktail.
storyNoteZh: 1838 年新奥尔良 Sazerac Coffee House 药剂师 Antoine Peychaud 发明，2008 年被路易斯安那州定为官方鸡尾酒。
storyNoteEn: Concocted in 1838 by Antoine Peychaud at the Sazerac Coffee House in New Orleans; named the official cocktail of Louisiana in 2008.

descriptionZh: 干邑、君度与柠檬的 20 世纪巴黎经典，糖边的优雅版本。
descriptionEn: Cognac, Cointreau and lemon — the elegant 1920s Parisian classic, often with a sugar rim.
storyNoteZh: 一战时期巴黎 Ritz 调酒师首创，因常被一位常坐摩托车边车的军官点单而得名。
storyNoteEn: Created in WWI Paris at the Ritz; named after a regular who arrived by motorcycle sidecar.

descriptionZh: 金酒、君度、柠檬与蛋清的绵密酸酒，1920 年代巴黎 Savoy 经典。
descriptionEn: Gin, Cointreau, lemon and egg white — the silky 1920s Paris/Savoy classic.
storyNoteZh: 1919 年伦敦或巴黎首创，1930 年 Harry Craddock 收录在 Savoy Cocktail Book 中。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1919, popularised by Harry Craddock in his 1930 Savoy Cocktail Book.

descriptionZh: 黑糖蜜朗姆、Campari、菠萝与青柠的现代 tiki 经典。
descriptionEn: Blackstrap rum, Campari, pineapple and lime — the modern tiki classic with a bitter edge.
storyNoteZh: 1978 年马来西亚吉隆坡 Hilton 酒店 Aviary Bar 调酒师发明。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1978 at the Aviary Bar of the Hilton in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

descriptionZh: 等比梅斯卡尔、黄查特、阿佩罗与青柠，烟雾与花香的紧凑对位。
descriptionEn: Equal parts mezcal, Yellow Chartreuse, Aperol and lime — smoke and floral in tight harmony.
storyNoteZh: 2011 年纽约 Death & Co 调酒师 Joaquín Simó 创作，是 Last Word 的烟熏后裔。
storyNoteEn: Created in 2011 by Joaquín Simó at Death & Co. in New York, a smoky descendant of the Last Word.

descriptionZh: 梅斯卡尔、阿佩罗、马拉斯奇诺与青柠的烟熏酸酒。
descriptionEn: Mezcal, Aperol, maraschino and lime — the smoky New York cocktail named after a Pink Floyd album.
storyNoteZh: 2009 年纽约 Death & Co 调酒师 Phil Ward 创作，名字取自 Pink Floyd《The Division Bell》。
storyNoteEn: Created in 2009 by Phil Ward at Death & Co. in New York, named after a Pink Floyd album.

descriptionZh: 黑糖蜜朗姆、falernum、青柠与安格斯特拉的加勒比经典。
descriptionEn: Blackstrap rum, falernum, lime and Angostura — the classic Caribbean short drink.
storyNoteZh: 19 世纪加勒比海盗与水手间的酒，起源模糊但与 Falernum 起源地巴巴多斯密切相关。
storyNoteEn: A 19th-century Caribbean sailor's drink, closely linked to falernum's birthplace of Barbados.

descriptionZh: 波本、金酒、青柠与姜汁啤酒的二战北非酒吧经典。
descriptionEn: Bourbon, gin, lime and ginger beer — the WWII North Africa bar classic.
storyNoteZh: 1942 年开罗 Shepheard's Hotel 调酒师 Joe Scialom 为驻北非的英美士兵创作。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1942 by Joe Scialom at Cairo's Shepheard's Hotel for Allied troops in WWII North Africa.

descriptionZh: 黑刺李金酒、杏子白兰地与青柠的无酒精 1920 年代经典。
descriptionEn: Sloe gin, apricot brandy and lime — the 1920s Chaplin-era sour.
storyNoteZh: 1920 年代以喜剧大师 Charlie Chaplin 命名的纽约 Waldorf-Astoria 鸡尾酒。
storyNoteEn: A 1920s New York cocktail named after Charlie Chaplin, popular at the Waldorf-Astoria.

descriptionZh: 白朗姆、干味美思、石榴糖浆与橙皮苦精的古巴经典。
descriptionEn: White rum, dry vermouth, grenadine and orange bitters — the Prohibition-era Cuban classic.
storyNoteZh: 1919-1933 年古巴哈瓦那由 Eddie Woelke 为 Gerardo Machado 总统调酒师发明。
storyNoteEn: Concocted in Havana 1919-33 by Eddie Woelke for Cuban President Gerardo Machado.

descriptionZh: 金酒、奶油、蛋清、橙花水与苏打的极致绵密新奥尔良菲士。
descriptionEn: Gin, cream, egg white, orange flower water and soda — the ultimate New Orleans fizz.
storyNoteZh: 1888 年新奥尔良 Imperial Cabinet Saloon 调酒师 Henry Ramos 发明；Ramos 时代单杯要摇 12 分钟。
storyNoteEn: Created in 1888 by Henry Ramos at the Imperial Cabinet Saloon in New Orleans; Ramos's original recipe required 12 minutes of shaking per drink.

descriptionZh: 等比苏格兰威士忌、甜味美思、樱桃希林与橙汁的 1920 年代同名电影经典。
descriptionEn: Equal parts scotch, sweet vermouth, Cherry Heering and orange juice — the 1920s film-title classic.
storyNoteZh: 1922 年同名斗牛士电影首演后由 Harry Craddock 收录于 1930 年《Savoy Cocktail Book》。
storyNoteEn: Published by Harry Craddock in 1930 Savoy Cocktail Book, named after the 1922 Rudolph Valentino bullfighter film.

descriptionZh: 白朗姆、可乐与青柠的极简古巴自由。
descriptionEn: White rum, cola and lime — the simplest Cuba Libre.
storyNoteZh: 1900 年古巴独立后由美国驻哈瓦那记者以 'Cuba Libre' 命名，朗姆可乐加上青柠。
storyNoteEn: Named 'Cuba Libre' by an American journalist in Havana in 1900 after Cuban independence, with a lime added.

descriptionZh: 金酒与青柠的极简酸酒，皇家海军抗坏血病药的现代后裔。
descriptionEn: Gin and lime in the simplest sour, the modern descendant of the Royal Navy's anti-scurvy cordial.
storyNoteZh: 19 世纪英国皇家海军外科医生 Thomas Gimlette 把柠檬汁混入金酒中给水兵喝。
storyNoteEn: Created by Royal Navy surgeon Thomas Gimlette in the 19th century to make his sailors' daily lime ration drinkable.

descriptionZh: 陈年朗姆取代波本的加勒比版古典鸡尾酒。
descriptionEn: Aged dark rum, sugar and bitters — the Caribbean's riff on the Old Fashioned.
storyNoteZh: 现代调酒师对 Old Fashioned 模板的常见延伸，使用陈年朗姆取代威士忌。
storyNoteEn: A modern bartender's riff on the Old Fashioned, swapping bourbon for aged rum.
